description: the integrator's own manifest: wiring a package asked for in its notes, kept out of the package's manifest so that the package's schema test and its file stay as pushed
notes: Wiring the packages asked for in their notes. smoke_rules: each package's stricter smoke module (a host-side module of scripts/ci with problems(env, container_text)) is called once per arm by c2_smoke_check.fusion_problems: WP1 tp4_shard_argmax_smoke (fold, words=1, tasks = 2 x workers, the audit for four chips), WP5 ccl_options_smoke (counts, canonical set name, one audit line per op and block owner), WP6 draft_wp6_smoke (chains, the fused gate|up, the mm grid), WP7 draft_permute_smoke (an engaged line per site and shape, a passing audit line per quad site), WP2 kv_page_writer_tp4_smoke (the generated rules plus an engaged line with ordered=0: the captured forward ran the page launch). pack_order: the integrated pack runs the levers by the plan's estimated saving per 8-live round (section 6.1, central values): permute -6.4 ms, s1 -1.85, head64 -1.78, ccl -2 (unknown), reduce -1.2, qkv1 -1.1, tail -0.8, gateup1, mmgrid; kvpage (-2.75) is last by pack_last. pack_include: the upload-p0 pack's six profile twins come from its own generator (make_upload_profiles.py); its templates A0-A3 and T0-T5 are folded into the integrated ORDER under the prefix UP (UPA0.., UPT0..), on the one image, with their NEEDS lines renamed (its B0 is the pack's X0).

pack_last.reason: WP2 lever cannot engage until the card-M proof (KVPAGE-W2 in fusion-jobs/WP2) passes and ordered_writer_evidence_tp4.json carries the page_writer block it records: until then the lever refuses (a fell-back line) and these four-card arms measure nothing, so they run last and only after that record lands.

pack_include.reason: tp4/upload-p0: the engine-start levers QWEN_FAST_DEVICE_ZEROS and QWEN_FAST_LAZY_SHARD_W (exactness A0-A3, then the engine-start ABAB T0-T5 read with engine_start_phases.py, which can run anywhere in the timed block).
